# PART 3 – Reproduction and exploration {.darkslide background-color="rgba(0,0,0,0)"}

::: {.partlabel}
Part 3
:::

::: notes
Welcome back, and anyone just rejoining will find what they missed on the catch-up card on the screen. The first two parts were mostly concepts, and this part puts them to work in code. You reproduce one of the results recorded in the robustness study, to the third decimal, choosing among three analysts. We then open the menu of the choices that I could have made instead, of which there are more than one would guess, go through what each does to the model, and you spend the last stretch working the menu yourself, so that by the end you have a sense of which choices move the answer.
:::
